name: 3can-resource-governor
description: Optional, lease-based coordination for conflicting local development resources.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate Docker, ports, and single-writer resources.
interface.longDescription: Adds an optional SQLite resource hub and lifecycle hooks. It coordinates conflicting resources without imposing a fixed agent limit or deleting Docker and Codex data.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the current 3CAN resource leases and any cleanup manifests for this project.
